In [[3660 BBY]], the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] '''attacked''' the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] holy [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]&mdash;the third conflict of the [[Great Galactic War]] to be focused on the ancient burial world. The battle was in the immediate aftermath of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] failed [[Battle of Ord Radama|conquest]] of [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]], which saw the destruction of a large Imperial strike force. The Sith survivors of Ord Radama were pursued back to the [[Seat of The Empire]] by the Republic Navy, which launched its short assault on Korriban upon arrival. The forces of the Empire rallied to strike back, but the Republic warships quickly pulled out of the [[Horuset system]] and regrouped above [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], where yet [[Battle of Ziost|another battle]] occurred.
